releases.notes:
- Target output volume/mute mirroring when the proxied device exposes hardware controls; otherwise Parametrique continues to own software volume (−25…0 dB). In mirror mode, Level uses the target’s native dB range and volume curve.
- Master **Balance** knob (under Level) when the target exposes a stereo pan control; reads/writes the target’s Balance directly.
- Settings toggle **Mirror hardware volume** (default on, persisted in the driver) to force software Level instead of forwarding to the target.
- Process attenuation control (0…−25 dB, L/R, gang-aware) for gain structure, always applied in software alongside EQ (unity when master EQ is bypassed).
- System audio robustness: ~20 ms soft-mute on route rebuild/stop, device-loss pause or follow-alive default, sleep/wake auto-resume, richer tap/aggregate diagnostics.
- Opt-in Settings toggle **Allow managing default system output** when switching Virtual device ↔ System audio (off by default).
- Opt-in **Minimize to menu bar on close** so Q can keep running after the window is closed (Open EQ / Settings / Quit from the status item).
- Active preset name next to Presets in the toolbar, with  when the curve diverges from that preset.
- Buffer size picker in System audio mode (same sizes as Virtual device); sets the private aggregate’s  before IO starts, with a short fade/rebuild when changed live.
- Permanent **Window → Parametrique** menu item to bring the EQ window back when it was closed to the menu bar.
- System audio permission alert that deep-links to Privacy Settings when Core Audio reports .
